name: Toshi Densetsu wa Hito o Kuu
source:
There is a rumor about "Tokiko's Cell Phone". If you call Tokiko, you'll need to remove her curse. If you don't, you'll die...

One day, Atsushi, who works at a cafe, accidentally calls Tokiko. He soon decides to take action to get rid of her curse with other workers. Well, will he be able to get rid of her curse or...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
流传着一个有关"时子的手机"的传闻。只要打电话给时子，就必须解除她的诅咒；否则便会死去…

一天，在咖啡馆工作的敦无意间打给了时子。不久后，他决定与其他员工一起采取行动，摆脱她的诅咒。那么，他究竟能否成功解除诅咒，还是说…？

[摘自ErogeShop]
